programs.rightsClaimSummary: BioCryst's 2026 Q2 filing reports continued U.S. ORLADEYO business and 2025 disposal of BioCryst Ireland European ORLADEYO business to Neopharmed, with amended intellectual-property licensing, supply and royalties. Historic APeX trials support an already approved product; October 2026 U.S. adult pellet approval is completed, not a pending PDUFA.

sourceDocuments.assertion: 2026 Q2 BioCryst Form 10-Q: U.S. ORLADEYO sales, 2025 sale of European BioCryst Ireland business to Neopharmed, amended licensing/royalty rights and single-source manufacturer disclosure.
October 21, 2026 issuer announced FDA adult/adolescent 12+ 150 mg oral-pellet sNDA approval. This was a completed event and must not be reported as upcoming PDUFA.
BioCryst official trial index identifies APeX-P NCT05453968 and APeX-A NCT04933721 as berotralstat studies. The ALPHA-ORBIT navenibart program is a distinct asset.
Exact ClinicalTrials.gov NCT and BCX7353/berotralstat intervention for APeX-2. Study does not itself establish a new FDA action target.

limitations: This dataset records source-linked company disclosure claims for current asset rights, coupled to exact historical NCT trial identifiers. The filings are company statements rather than independent contract adjudication. Previously completed U.S./EU product approvals must not become new PDUFA targets. Existing trial sponsorship or a different formulation/indication alone does not establish FDA acceptance, unencumbered rights, or eligible Pipeline membership.
